meta.title: Sat2Soil — From Satellite to Soil
meta.description: Field-scale decision support built on NASA Earth observation data: water, crop rotation, climate fit and digital twin scenarios.

landing.lead: We combine NASA Earth observation data with field analysis to give you practical, explainable decision support for your fields.
landing.intelTitle: Intelligence from space for your field
landing.intelLead: An integrated farming tool that reaches from satellite data to the field.

monitor.title: Follow your field's climate from space
monitor.body: Daily NASA POWER series for your field's location: rain, temperature, humidity, wind and sunlight.

decide.title: Make better-informed decisions
decide.body: Compare water needs and crop rotation plans, with every assumption spelled out.

twin.title: Build your field's digital twin
twin.body: Try what-if scenarios such as a dry year or another crop, kept clearly apart from observed data.

field.title: Choose a field
field.body: Open the sample field in the Konya Plain or draw your own on satellite imagery.

data.title: See NASA data for its location
data.body: Real NASA POWER series for the grid cell around your field, with source, unit and date.

decide.title: Compare plans
decide.body: Water balance and crop rotation options, explained step by step.

landing.dataLead: We say exactly where each number comes from, including the sources that are not connected yet.
landing.gridNote: Satellite and model data describe a grid cell, not a point measurement inside your field.
landing.footerData: Data: NASA POWER and NASA GIBS. Sat2Soil is not affiliated with or endorsed by NASA.
landing.builtAt: Built at NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 · Konya
landing.spaceAppsAlt: NASA Space Apps Challenge Konya logo
